explanation: The tower had opened only two years earlier, in 1931. Kong himself was mostly a small jointed model, moved a fraction at a time by animator Willis O'Brien.

claims.text: In King Kong (1933), Kong climbs the Empire State Building in the film's finale.
In the original King Kong film, Kong does not climb the Chrysler, Woolworth or Flatiron buildings at the climax.
The Empire State Building opened in 1931.
Kong was brought to life mainly with small jointed models, animated frame by frame by Willis O'Brien.
